findings.question: Official gazette and legislation (Authentic text of laws and regulations): the name of the register or system
findings.quote: Informações e possibilidade de realizar online a consulta de diplomas no Diário da República, o jornal oficial da república portuguesa.
findings.quote_english: Information and the possibility to consult legal instruments online in the Diário da República, the official journal of the Portuguese Republic.
findings.value: Diário da República (Official Journal of the Portuguese Republic)
findings.title: Consultar o Diário da República online
findings.note: Government services portal page (updated 03.09.2026) names the Diário da República as the official journal; different URL from the earlier INCM page.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim on the page and names the Diário da República as Portugal's official journal, which is where laws and regulations are consulted.
